lines.en: : Hi.
: Oh, okay. Well, I guess my turn is over now. Later, Sensei!
: Later, Rin. See you tomorrow unless something tragic suddenly happens to me.
: Sorry. Did I interrupt something?
: Yes, Io. You quite literally interrupted something. I have no idea what else that word could possibly mean to you if you need to ask me this question right now.
: Asking that was mostly just a formality I decided to employ to appear more normal and less rude.
: I technically knew I was interrupting something. I just didn’t really care because my thing is more important than condoms.
: Most things are. But go ahead, shoot. Just let the record show that I have plans both tonight and tomorrow. So if you’re trying to hang out with me, you’re going to need to schedule something ASAP.
: I probably won’t have time to hang out at all this weekend, so you can give my slot to somebody else. I’m too busy being mature and working damage control to be frantic and anxious right now.
: Damage control for what exactly?
: Before I answer that question, are you also only asking something to appear more normal and less rude? Because it’d be really weird if you didn’t actually know yet and I’m pretty sure you do.
: Does it involve a certain maid and certain things that maid may have done before she was a maid?
: Okay, so you do know.
: I take it Uta’s not handling it well then? And that you need me to go cheer her up since there’s only so much you can do on your own?
: No. In fact, I’d like you to do the exact opposite of that since she really, really likes you and will probably start crying out of shame or something if she sees you right now.
: So just...avoid her all weekend? That’s easier said than done. Especially immediately after I just alluded to something tragic happening. Uta could very well be that tragic thing, Io.
: It’ll probably be as simple as to just not go looking for her, honestly. I was able to talk to Touka about getting Uta and me a room of our own and she’s in there with AC blasting right now.
: You talked to Touka? Willingly? On your own?
: You should have seen me in the classroom. I stood up and yelled at everyone and I didn’t even have a panic attack until I got home.
: I have to be serious Io right now, Sensei. Uta’s always the one looking out for me and if I can’t repay that when she needs me most, what good even am I?
: And don’t actually answer that question because I already know I’m just no good at all.
: Walk with me.
: Okay.
Io and I take off down the beach as I start walking her back to the inn. And while it’s nice to see this protective side of her, I can’t help but feel bad about the circumstances that brought it out.

Feeling bad about the leakage of someone’s childhood nudes is kind of just the baseline of having compassion, though. So don’t give me too much credit when I’m pretty sure everyone feels bad right now.
: So, like...I heard about this from Ami obviously. But I didn’t really pry any details out of her.
: You didn’t get any pictures then?
: Not this time, no. Though, I’m not really sure what sort of details they’d provide if I did.
: None really. I just wanted to confirm that I don’t need to snatch your phone away and throw it into the ocean.
: You probably still do, to be honest. It’s practically a portable bank of potential charges against me at this point.

: Sure, but at least you’re talking about stuff you obtained with consent. Or at least I hope you’re talking about stuff you obtained with consent. But I care less about everyone else than I do about Uta right now.
: Which is also just how I feel literally all of the time. But it’s especially true right now since our entire class has suddenly violated her privacy. Albeit accidentally, but still.
: It was just...a random text chain then? Like, everyone got them?
: I originally thought it was just our class, but...yeah. I think pretty much any cell phone inside of the school was sent those pictures.
: And given how many people are acquainted with Uta as a result of her merely existing, it didn’t take long for word to get around about who was in those pictures.
: And how is she handling all of this? Apart from bad enough to warrant damage control and the very rare “Serious Io?”
: Exactly how I thought she would if she was ever confronted with news of her past getting out.

: She’s still smiling and saying everything is fine. That she doesn’t care if anyone knows this about her since it’s just a “part of who she is” or whatever else her counselors fed her to make her accept things.
: It’s all a lie, though. Surely you know Uta’s smile by now. So you’d be able to discern a forced one with no issues at all. She’s operating off of auto-pilot, basically.
: Like, I didn’t even want her to come here but she just kept insisting on it because she just wants everything to be normal again when she knows deep down, nothing will ever be “normal” again.

: You don’t know that for sure, though. Like, apart from Ami the day it happened and you right now, no one’s said anything about this to me at all. So I can’t imagine anyone is talking to her about it.
: It’s not about whether anyone talks about it, Sensei. It’s about whether or not they know.

: Uta’s cultivated an image for herself that she’s proud of. She’s finally going to a school where rumors about her aren’t circulating like crazy. Or...at least they weren’t. But that’s obviously changed.
: So now it’s back to square one and she’s never going to feel comfortable again. Which sucks extra hard since there’s literally nowhere else to run to now.
: Is she still going to school? Do the teachers know about-
: Everyone knows. Yet, Uta’s still showing up like nothing even happened.

: Miss Imai’s been trying to talk to her and, like, be supportive or whatever. But it’s not going to change anything. So the only way for Uta to overcome it is to literally change herself. Again. And that worries me.
: She’s always been stronger than me. And I’ve looked up to her since we met because of that...
: But there’s only so much a person can take and, if she has to keep rewriting herself like this, who’s to say what will be left of the girl at the core of it all?
: Well, I was about to ask how I can help, but it doesn’t seem like I can.
: I just don’t understand how this could have been avoided...
: Like, it’s weird. This isn’t just one person we’re talking about. This isn’t pictures being sent to you or me or her but an entire fucking school. How does that even happen?
: Who would do that? Why is everyone so fucking evil? Why can’t we just live our lives without people trying to rape us or exploit us everywhere we look?
: Sorry, I...
: I’m just not really handling this as well as I hoped.

: And it’s dredging up a bunch of shitty memories that will inevitably make me shitty as a result. And so both of us are just going to dissolve into nothing but scorn and shame and then eventually disappear.
: Well, I’d greatly prefer if neither of you disappeared. Weird things just...happen sometimes. Especially here, of all places.
: What is that supposed to mean?
: Uta will know what it means. And if she doesn’t, she’ll learn soon.
: This place is nothing like she hopes...but I think she’ll get through it, Io.
: We both know that shame never fully wears off. But it does get easier to ignore sometimes. And if Uta’s come this far, who are we to fear where else she’ll go?
: Yes, but at least we don’t have our shame paraded in front of us and distributed to all of our peers. If anything, Uta has it even worse than we do.
: She can’t even hide. So how are we supposed to help as two people who do nothing but avoid our pasts?

: I confront my past every day now. The issue with me is that I always let it win. But Uta isn’t like us. And if she’s as strong as you say, maybe we can learn from her how to become better people after all of this blows over.
: And if it doesn’t?...
: If she lets the past win the same way you do, won’t she become just as much of a monster?
: There’s a chance nothing good comes out of this. That someone is sending those things to all of us because they want to break her then marvel at the mess that she becomes.
: Just, if Uta breaks, so will I. How could I not when she’s been my anchor this whole time?
: You’ve wrapped too much of yourself up in her, Io. You’re the only one who gets to define who and what you are.
: No...I’m not. That choice was made for me a long time ago and there is nothing I can do to escape it. Uta’s the one who got out. She knows how to become something else.
: Then I say we let her.
: If she wants to act like nothing happened, let her. If she wants to lie in bed with the AC blasting while avoiding all human contact, let her.
: But what if she wants to do something bad?...
: Do we let her do that as well?
: There’s something weird about all of this, Sensei.
: Something I can’t quite put my finger on.
: There’s no way real life is supposed to be this depressing, right?...
Io stayed quiet for the rest of the walk back when I couldn’t come up with an answer. I still don’t know what “real life” is.

Because if Descartes is right and my previous statements confirms as much, this life is real. And that, by even being able to wonder if it is or not, I’m creating some sort of paradox where I have realer thoughts somewhere else.
Then that me has “realer” thoughts and it goes on and on and on for all eternity.
Yes, strange things happen in this place. And yes, I’ve been taught to believe that most of them are unrealistic. That they don’t fit in with what “reality” is meant to be. But that’s just it.
I think that way because that’s how I was taught to think. And if what someone else was taught contradicts that, that creates a paradox too.

Who says “real life” can’t be this depressing? Who says it isn’t the most depressing thing that can possibly exist? And why would we even listen to whoever that is in the first place when this world is supposed to be what we make of it? Not them.
Be it fact or fiction, truth or false, what matters most is how it makes you feel.
I don’t want to leave this place because I don’t think it should exist.
I want to leave it because it makes me sad.
: I went back to that hole recently...
: The one where we kissed for the first time.
: Uhh...cool? Kind of a weird time to bring that up, though.
: I saw my mother there.
: And then she was gone.
: Io-
: I...don’t think it was actually her. I think I was just seeing things in the dark or...something like that.
: But I’m afraid to go back now.
: And I wonder if...
: I wonder if I only saw that in the first place because something or...someone didn’t want me to keep looking around in there.
: That’s-
: Weird, I know. And...kind of random.
: But all this talk or...lack of talk about what’s real or make believe has got me thinking.
: If this is just some kind of story...and all we are is characters dropped in to make it more interesting...
: What reason would there possibly be to keep us from exploring?
: And why did they have to make us all so sad?...
: Thanks for walking me back, Sensei.
: I’m...gonna go spend some time with Uta now.
Io wanders off after leaving me somewhat speechless. Again.
She’s getting good at that.
It’s all ridiculous, though.
She saw her mother because that’s what scares her.
It’s the same reason I see you every time I close my eyes.
: Hey. Still doing okay in here?
: Mhm. Just watching TV.
: Yeah, I...I can see that.
: It looks like my show ended, though.
: Did you run into Sensei?
: Is he coming?
: Uta...
: I think today’s going to be the day, Io.
: I think I’m finally going to lose my virginity.
: I’m so excited, I can barely breathe.
: Have you taken your medication yet?
: I don’t understand why I can’t have grapefruit.
: Uta, you need to-
: I took it, don’t worry. I love you, Io.
: Thank you for always taking care of me.
: Do you want the remote? We can...watch a movie together or something?
: He isn’t coming, is he?
: You don’t want to see him right now, Uta.
: Okay. If that’s what you think is best.
: Would you rather I leave you alone?
: No, you can stay. I’m fine.
: You’re not-
: I said I’m fine.
: I said I’m-
: I know.
: I heard you the first time...
Io’s affection has increased to [io_love]!
